title_sq: Shesim njesi comerciale tek kompleksi Halili
description_sq: Shesim njesi comerciale tek kompleksi Halili ne katin 0. Njesia gjendet ne pjesen e brendeshme te kompleksit dhe ka aksesueshmeri te mire nga te treja hyrjet e kompleksit. Siperfaqja e njesise eshte 33.4 m2 neto. Ka forme te rregullt kuadratike me fasade xhami nga te dyja anet. Aktualisht ambjenti eshte i dhen me qera. Pozicionimi ne lidhje me qendren e ben shume te favorshem per tipologji te ndryshme biznesi. Per me shume info apo nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni.
title_en: We are selling a commercial unit in the Halili complex
description_en: We are selling a commercial unit in the Halili complex on floor 0. The unit is located in the inner part of the complex and has good accessibility from the three entrances of the complex. The area of ​​the unit is 33.4 m2 net. It has a regular square shape with glass facades on both sides. Currently, the space is rented. The positioning in relation to the center makes it very favorable for different types of business. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us.
